title: Barnacle Knight
personality:
A ferryman who carried refugees across the ice the night of the Hollowing and sank his own ship so they could reach shore. The sea remade him: his hull became his armour, his brass diving helmet never comes off, and the ship's compass is set in his chest, with the sea's cyan light glowing between the hull planks.
He doesn't remember his old name, only the children's faces. The teddy bear belonged to the last child he saved.
fantasy: The squad's shield. Holds the line with his aegis, plants his hammer where the fight is, and heals the spot.
silhouette: the frozen prow shield and the long ice-cased oar

card.loop: Frontline tank: block with your aegis, then knock foes into walls with your hammer to stun them.
card.role: Frontline tank: block with your aegis, then knock foes into walls with your hammer to stun them.
card.lmb: Tap to throw the hammer to the cursor and tap again to call it back; hold to spin it, let go to slam forward; let go as it flashes and the slam launches you.
card.rmb: Hold to raise your aegis and block shots from the front. With it up, Shift is a Shield Charge on its own cooldown.
card.e: A green light comes down on your hammer (or on you), then a healing zone round it ticks and ends in a burst.
card.dash: 360 Smash: a short dash that ends in one spinning hit around you; with the aegis up, a Shield Charge (its own 6s cooldown).
card.passive: Blocking builds Guard (50 turns your Shield Charge into a Shield Slam); knocking a foe into a wall or another foe stuns it.
card.x: Faultline (level 6): plant, slam, and the ground erupts down a long lane, throwing every foe on it up.

weapons.tower_shield: Tap to throw the hammer to the cursor and tap again to call it back; hold to spin it, let go to slam forward; let go as it flashes and the slam launches you.

passive.name: Guard
passive.desc: Damage your aegis blocks becomes Guard (1 per 2 blocked, max 100); at 50 your Shield Charge ends in a Shield Slam (push 12, stun 0.6, spends 50). Crushed: any knock of yours (Crushing Blow, 360 Smash, Shield Charge, Shield Slam) that drives a foe into a wall or another foe stuns it 0.5 (8 damage).

dash.name: 360 Smash
dash.desc: 360 Smash: a hard 3.5m dash (0.17s) that slides on through one full spin of the hammer around you (2.2m): 24 damage, push 7. With the aegis raised it's a Shield Charge on its own 6s cooldown (it spends no dash charge): 4.2m behind the aegis, invulnerable for its length, 10 damage and push 11 (into a wall or a foe: Crushed). Shift while winding up a Crushing Blow: a short plain dash, the blow still charging.

variants.hold: Raise the aegis: a curved gold shield with 160 HP that regenerates; it blocks shots from the front and you walk slower. With it up, Shift is the Shield Charge on this slot's 6s cooldown.
variants.tap: A tap only raises and lowers the aegis; the Bash is the Shield Charge on Shift.
variants.air: Shield Surf: hold to block from the front while gliding.
variants.full: Guard 50+: the Shield Charge ends in a Shield Slam, 18 damage, push 12 and stun 0.6 (spends 50).

e.name: Mending Ground
e.desc: A green light column comes down for 1s on your hammer (on you with the hammer in hand), then the zone round it heals allies inside 2 every 0.5s for 4s, following the hammer, and ends in a burst of 18; if your aegis is raised the burst mends it 60. A downed teammate inside is a third of the way back up at the burst.

x.name: Faultline
x.desc: Plant and raise the hammer (0.4s, the 16m lane shows to everyone), then slam (planted 0.2s more; then you move freely while it runs): the fissure races down the lane, striking each foe on it (4, stun 0.5), and the ground erupts cell by cell to the far end, throwing each foe up once (18, slowed 50% for 1.5s). A wall or a raised ledge stops it. A glowing scar stays 10s and slows foes on it 20%.

rank3.sec: shield HP +50% in all and it repairs and regenerates faster
rank3.dash: the 360 Smash refunds the Shield Charge when it hits
rank3.kin: Mending Ground's cooldown drops to 8s and it heals 50% more in all

rank2.dash: Rank 2: recharge 8s -> 6.8s per charge; the Shield Charge cooldown 6s -> 4.5s.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: shield HP +50% (240), damage +30%; regen 20 -> 30 per second, back up in 1.4s and 2s when broken.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 8s -> 5.6s; the Shield Charge cooldown 6s -> 3s; a 360 Smash that hits refunds it.

tells.half: three rune pips over the helm light at 33 / 66 / 100 Guard
tells.full: a gold crest light and a hotter aegis; a 0.3s flare before a Slam
